title: energizing jamaican leek rice bowl
description: a vibrant, sweet, and energizing jamaican dish featuring leek, dum, and raw-friendly ingredients. perfect for a quick weeknight meal.
instructions: heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
add chopped leek and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 8 minutes.
add diced mango, coconut milk, scotch bonnet peppers, cumin, coriander, turmeric, salt, and black pepper. stir to combine.
bring to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until the mixture has thickened and the flavors have melded, about 12 minutes.
stir in cooked jasmine rice and cook, stirring constantly, until heated through, about 2-3 minutes.
serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
cover and refrigerate leftovers for up to 3 days, reheating in the microwave or oven until warmed through.
